entries.summary: In the presence of Bishop Albert of Trento, John, abbot of Biburg, and Bertha, abbess of Sonnenburg, settle a dispute over holdings on the mountain of Aldein; the Biburg party relinquishes its claims in exchange for compensation. Henricus de Rosenpach is named as a witness.
entries.latin: (SN) In nomine Domini. Die mercurii qui fuit octavus intrante mense iulii, in presentia domini Conradi comitis de Flaun, magistri Romani, Wale canonicorum Tridentinorum, Conradi, Albani, Fedrici, Bertoldi de Romeno presbiterorum, Amelrici de Welfsperg, Heccardi Garri, Ottonis et Fedrici ger(manorum), Wernardi, Cadlochi, Gothsalcia) de Winec, Henrici de Rosenpach, Henrici Swarci de Bauçanob), Sigardi, Rodulfi, Folcmari, Tatoldi, Pabi, Diapoldi et Fedrici gastaldionis ministerialium ecclesie de Souanburg et aliorum plurium. Dominus Iohannes, abbas monasterii de Piburg, una cum Gotfredo eius monacho, per se et omnes suos monachos et confratresc) et nomine et vice tocius congregationis et monasterii de Piburg transegit et finem inrevocabilem atque decisionem inresolubilem fecit adversus dominam Perehtham, Souanburgensisd) ecclesie abbatissam, eiusque monasterii conventum in perpetuum nominative de omni lite et querimonia seu actione, inquisitione aut peticione quam diutissime adversus prefatam dominam abbatissam et eius monasterium nomine octo mansuum quos prememoratum comitem Conradum s(ib)i in monte Aldeni dedisse dicebat, qualitercumque habuit vel haberet seu habere posset, ita videlicet ut non liceat ipsi, qui supra, domino abbati aut eius successoribus nomine sue congregationis aut monasterii qualibete) sumpta occasione per se vel per interpositam perso nam per quodvis ingenium quolibet in tempore agere vel causari seu placitumf) aut intentionem aliquam movere de suprascriptis octo mansibus adversus prememoratam dominam abbatissam vel eius succedentes aut suum conventum seu monasterium, sed exinde cum suis monachis et con fratribus et successoribus tacitus et contentus permaneat in perpetuum. De quo suprascripto fine prefata domina abbatissa quindecim libras denariorum ratisponensisg) monete suprascripto domino abbati aut tantum argenti quod pro eis summere vellet usque ad proximum sancti Martini festum dare vadiavit, cuius vadie dominus Albertus Tridentine sedis illustris episcopus fideiussor extitit, quia sic inter eos convenit. Actum est hoc in choro ecclesie Sancte Marie monasterii de Owa, feliciter, presente et coram domino illustri Alberto, Tridentine sedis venerabili episcopo, residente ibidem ad iusticiam faciendam inter prefatum dominum abbatem ex una parte et inter predictam dominamh) abbatissam ex altera de lite et controversia suprascriptorum octo mansuum que inter ipsos ventilabaturi), que lis et controversia suprascripto modo est decisa. Est etiam suprascriptus finisj) factus in manum prememorati domini episcopi summentem una cum prefata domina abbatissa, qualiter superius legitur in integrum. Anno dominice nativitatis millesimo centesimo octuagesimo septimo, indictione quinta. (SN) Ego Albertus, domini Fedrici imperatoris invict(issimi) notarius, suprascripto fini interfui et rogatus in publicum redegi et scripsi.
entries.english:
In the name of the Lord. On Wednesday, the eighth day of July, in the presence of Count Conrad of Flaun, Master Romanus, Wale, canons of Trento; Conradus, Albanus, Fedricus and Bertoldus, priests; Amelricus of Welfsperg; Heccardus Garri; Otto and Fedricus, brothers; Wernardus, Cadlochus, Gothsalc of Wineck, Henry of Rosenpach, Henry Swart of Bolzano, Sigardus, Rodulfus, Folcmarus, Tatoldus, Pabus, Diapoldus and Fedricus the gastaldus, ministerials of the church of Sonnenburg, and many others.

Lord John, abbot of the monastery of Biburg, together with his monk Gotfredus, acting for himself and all his monks and confreres, and in the name and on behalf of the entire congregation and monastery of Biburg, made an irrevocable settlement and final resolution with Lady Bertha, abbess of the church of Sonnenburg, and her convent, concerning in perpetuity every dispute, complaint, claim, inquiry or petition that he had for a very long time brought or might bring against the aforesaid abbess and her monastery on account of the eight manses which he said the aforementioned Count Conrad had given him on Mount Aldein, however he had held, might hold, or could hold them. Accordingly, it shall not be lawful for the aforesaid abbot or his successors, on behalf of his congregation or monastery, on any pretext, personally or through an intermediary, by any device and at any time, to bring an action or lawsuit, or raise any claim concerning the aforesaid eight manses against the aforesaid abbess, her successors, her convent or monastery. Instead, with his monks, confreres and successors, he shall remain forever silent and satisfied on this matter.

In consideration of this settlement, the aforesaid abbess undertook to give the aforesaid abbot fifteen pounds of Regensburg denarii, or so much silver as he might choose to take in their place, by the next feast of Saint Martin. Lord Albert, illustrious bishop of the see of Trento, stood surety for this undertaking, as they had agreed between them.

This was done successfully in the choir of the church of Saint Mary at the monastery of Owa, in the presence of and before Lord Albert, illustrious and venerable bishop of the see of Trento, who was sitting there to administer justice between the aforesaid abbot on one side and the aforesaid abbess on the other, concerning the dispute and controversy over the aforesaid eight manses then pending between them; that dispute and controversy was resolved in the manner stated above. The aforesaid settlement was also made into the hands of the aforesaid bishop, who received it together with the aforesaid abbess, in full, as written above. In the year of the Lord’s nativity 1187, indiction five. I, Albert, notary of the most invincible Lord Emperor Frederick, was present at the aforesaid settlement and, at the parties’ request, drew it up as a public instrument and wrote it.

facts.subject: Heinrich de Rosenpach
facts.content: is named as a witness to the settlement.
